question: Approve the DRC-4602 rewrite and milestone correction for writing to Linear, and the six acceptance criteria and declared surface as implementation's contract.

artifacts.summary: The stage refused to inherit any of the three counts in circulation and wrote a composing auditor instead - one that expands the font shorthand, dereferences the size tokens, and resolves size, family and line-height through the cascade - and it reproduces both cases the DRC-4587 review measured live and that a rule-level census structurally cannot see. Its own figures then moved under it, 38 selectors across 31 rules at one commit and 33 across 27 forty minutes later, because DRC-4587 was still committing to the branch being measured. The conclusion is that the count is not the deliverable: the rewrite ships the repository-resident composed audit with the raise as its consequence, and every criterion re-derives its baseline at implementation.
